verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe GitHub integration so developers can write code locally or in Base44 and keep the two in sync (base44-docs-2, base44-docs-18). They also document a CLI that syncs data models and code and deploys resources from the terminal (base44-docs-5, base44-docs-35, base44-docs-24), so local editing with your own tooling and pushing changes back is clearly covered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the local-to-platform round-trip works reliably, and detail on sync and conflict behavior (eject creates a separate app rather than pushing back to the original).
